Khadaganian expedition camp


Setting

The Khadaganian expedition has established a foothold on Gipath in pursuit of the meteorite. Zak’s capture connects its officers, the Hermit Lizard and the struggle over the island’s secrets. [1, 2, 3]

The expedition and the Hermit’s bargain

Estera introduces a lost Khadaganian official, who promises that his expedition can help Zak leave Gipath. Meeting Expedition commander instead leads to imprisonment and demands for information about a meteorite. Zak plays the ignorant swineherd, but the commander threatens torture. Hermit lizard offers escape on the condition that Zak later visit his home. Zak gives his word, receives the Ancient Claw for the traps on the approach and escapes. The Hermit explains that he had intended to negotiate with the armoured humans but changed his mind after seeing their treatment of Zak. Keeping the promise establishes trust where the expedition failed to do so. [4, 2, 5, 6, 7, 3]
